arguments.text: Implemented work.py evaluate(request, policy): copies supplied defaults; applies layers in order; rejects unknown layer/environment keys; resets null only when null_resets is exactly true; gates environment overrides on policy.environment; parses only exact lowercase boolean strings and strict optional-minus decimal integer strings; copies string overrides; defers exact type validation until all overrides; rejects bool as integer; emits exact ok/config/error fields. report.json equals evaluation of current requests.json with current policy.json. Local test observed 11 boundary cases plus report consistency passing, including false/zero/empty preservation, overwrite-before-type-check, null reset/non-reset, strict environment syntax, disabled environment, bool-not-int, and unknown keys.
